concept: A custom double-O ligature: two interlocking loops weave over and under each other, turning the 'oo' in Loom into the core brand signature.

typography.wordmark: Inter Display Bold with a custom outlined OO ligature
typography.supporting: Inter Display Medium, outlined in SVG

notes: The logo's custom OO replaces stock lettering in the wordmark.
Two loop paths use alternating gaps to create an over-under interlace.
No bitmap elements, gradients, shadows, filters or stock iconography in the vector masters.
